entries.10f99ca23977cce9: A reportable segment that delivers foods, mainly the Company's own, and household goods directly to individual members nationwide. It sells products made in the Production and Wholesale Business and other businesses, and goods purchased from outside suppliers, to members. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,660 million (down 1.8% from the same period of the previous year), and operating profit was ¥35 million (up 18.0%). The securities report states that, although price revisions had an effect, the number of new members decreased against the background of growing consumer thrift-mindedness and other factors, the order rate fell, and sales decreased. Operating profit increased because, although sales decreased and personnel expenses rose, the effect of price revisions was joined by productivity improvements from improvements in picking operations and other areas. In addition, as a result of calculating the recoverable amount of fixed assets in light of changes in the business environment, an impairment loss of ¥143 million was recorded for this segment and the Chinese subsidiary combined. In November 2023, a new distribution center was built to respond to increased sales in the direct sales business.
entries.13d1d34d0e7c0111: Provides safe meat, processed foods, eggs and milk that do not rely on pesticides, chemical fertilizers, antibiotics or other drugs, or chemical additives. The securities report states that technology development has been pursued since food production began in 1972, including drug-free rearing of broiler chickens, development of fully plant-based feed, and making feed ingredients non-genetically modified. In the Direct Sales Business, the company delivers food, centered on its own products, and daily goods to members.

entries.4688620abbb5dddf: Sales destinations of the Production and Wholesale Business are mainly direct-delivery type consumer cooperatives, delivery companies, supermarkets and retail stores. entries.4a7c84800a3f9c5c: A reportable segment that makes and sells chicken, frozen processed foods, eggs, milk, and other products, mainly to direct-from-producer consumer cooperatives and home delivery companies. It is the segment with the larger sales to external customers of the two reportable segments. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,622 million (up 5.7% from the same period of the previous year), and operating profit was ¥558 million (up 35.5%). The securities report states that, as demand grew for chicken, which offers a sense of value, against the background of consumers' thrift-mindedness, sales were strong, mainly of frozen processed foods, and sales increased, helped by the effect of product price revisions. Although there were higher costs for raw materials and packaging materials and higher personnel expenses, profit increased because the effects of sales expansion and price revisions were joined by productivity improvements at the frozen food factory and the meat factory. Customers are consumer cooperatives, mass retailers, retail stores, and others; as a share of consolidated sales, Green Coop Federation accounted for 21.5% and Seikatsu Club Consumers' Co-operative Union accounted for 16.8%.

entries.b4de753561640bd0: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,283 million (up 4.1% year on year). The Production and Wholesale Business recorded ¥6,622 million (up 5.7%), and the Direct Sales Business ¥1,660 million (down 1.8%). Sales of frozen processed foods in particular were strong, and the effect of product price revisions also contributed. On the other hand, in the Direct Sales Business, the number of new members decreased and the order rate fell, as consumers became more frugal, among other reasons.
entries.b8f6616663d20267: Chicken and processed foods such as frozen processed foods. entries.b945f3b4346d6dae: Gross profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,097 million (up 9.9% year on year), and the gross profit margin was 25.3%, up 1.3 percentage points from the previous fiscal year. Operating profit was ¥143 million (an operating loss of ¥3 million in the previous fiscal year), and ordinary profit was ¥186 million (up 262.2% year on year); ordinary profit was also supported by an increase in government subsidy income resulting from soaring feed prices. On the other hand, the company recorded impairment losses of ¥143 million on fixed assets of the Direct Sales Business and the Chinese subsidiary, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥21 million (down 22.6% year on year).
